thread:
June K.: dropped a compact prototype for a 'board' in the trace viewer: https://figma.com/s/trace-board-compact-2
June K.: Idea: pin requests to a temporary investigation board. Features: reorder, add short notes (250 char limit), export (JSON/CSV/trace-bundle.zip), copy permalink. Looking for copy + a11y + keyboard thoughts.
Theo M.: quick thoughts: like the inline notes. Suggest tooltip copy: 'Pin request' (short). Button label: 'Pin'. Board header: 'Investigation board' with a small hint: 'Pins stay in this browser tab'.
Ravi S.: implementation: client-side localStorage first. Add a keyboard shortcut (P) when a trace row is focused to pin/unpin. Show small undo toast after pin: 'Pinned. Undo' with 5s countdown. Cap to 20 pins; show overflow hint 'Board full'.
a11y-bot: checklist: pin control must be keyboard reachable and announce state with aria-pressed. Shortcut must be documented and skip-able for screen reader users. Toast should use role='status' and aria-live polite, include undo button that is keyboard focusable.
June K.: export details: CSV and JSON by default. For complex exports offer 'trace bundle' (.zip) containing JSON + stacktrace.txt + metadata.json. Filenames: 'redwood-trace-<shortid>.json' and bundles 'redwood-trace-<shortid>-bundle.zip'. Include UTF-8 BOM for CSV.
Theo M.: discoverability: small header badge with count + a collapsible dock in trace view. Badge opens board; dock is dismissible with ESC. On mobile collapse to full-screen panel.
Ravi S.: perf note: streaming exports + progress bar for bundles. Limit the number of spans per export and show a warning if truncated. Telemetry events: board.open, pin.add, pin.remove, export.start, export.finish, copy.permalink.
June K.: copy nits: hover tooltip 'Pin request', action 'Pin' (toggle), board action 'Copy link' not 'Copy permalink' (shorter), export CTA 'Download selection'. Avoid the word 'session' in CTAs.
a11y-bot: recommend aria-describedby for tooltips, role='dialog' for board with focus trap, restore focus on close, ensure high-contrast colors for pin icon states. Also ensure keyboard-only flow can reorder pins (move up/down buttons).
June K.: action items: June - update figma with badge+dock + keyboard shortcut note; Theo - prototype keyboard nav and undo toast; Ravi - spike localStorage + export streaming behind flag; a11y-bot - add checklist to the figma comments. ETA: prototype in 1 sprint if scoped to client-only.
Theo M.: +1 to ETA. June - please post a 10s demo GIF after updates.
June K.: thanks all :heart: will iterate and post updates.
